summary: Decent Holding Inc. (NASDAQ: DXST), a China-based wastewater treatment and senior-care provider, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing plans to deploy up to 3,000 Taihao Intelligent AI health-management robots across selected centers in its roughly 700-site senior-care network, building on a previously disclosed partnership with Anhui Taihao Intelligent Technology. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or closing date is disclosed; quantity, timing, and scope remain subject to product availability, commercial terms, implementation readiness, demand, and regulatory conditions. This is an ordinary business development update, not a special situation; watch execution and financing risk.
